description: The whole coding loop on one deliberate yes: map, spec, critic-hardened plan, GitHub issues, parallel worktree implementers, fresh-context review loops, one PR with the evidence. Acts only on its itemized charter; parks what it can't settle honestly. Commands: /autopilot <task> [--merge], resume, status. It signs a charter and pushes branches, so it never auto-triggers — explicit invocation only.
